title: Putting On Airs!
body:
Subhanallah, Sultanallah Even if we stand up for the honour of our Lord for eternity; bow in
Ruku and make sajdah forever, O our Lord, it would be like we did nothing to honour the Lord.
You are Qadir Muqtadir, oh our Lord! MashaAllah. La quwwata illa billahil aliyyil azim. Blow
on yourself, so the air of those who have the sacred breath may reach you.
Lets go! Where shall we go? Lets go to the Snowy Mountain. What is there? There is fresh air. It
revives the people. Let's go there for at least one or two days, or for even a couple of hours, and
breathe in the fresh air of the mountain. People say like this. They look for air and aura.
Ey yaran. Shah Mardan. Lets say Bismillahir rahmanir rahim. Be like a Dragon. Be strong as if
you can knock down a mountain. If you grasp the cape of the Cyprus Island, you can pull it
along.They are Rijalullah,they are the holy ones in the service of the Lord. Know this,may you
understand. May our day be good. May our assembly be good. Ey yaran Shah Mardan Rikabi
estere merdane bas. Ride your animal like a man. Make the animal you ride be in your air (obey
you), not you be in its air. MashaAllah.
Let's say Bismillahir rahmanir rahim. Let's have some fresh air. Some say that "ooo he is putting
on airs." Why does he have airs? Don't you see his manners, the way he walks? You see his size,
his airs? What "airs" he has! Hasha minal hudur.What is the benefit of his airs if he lives a sinful
life? How is the air around someone who is on the Snowy Mountain? Let's breathe in its air.
People say,this man is putting on airs.Ya! He has airs! O Shah Mardan, you are the one for
whom it's appropriate to put on airs/be proud. The servant of Allah who is Jalil will not be
contemptable. The arena is yours, Shah Mardan.
Ey yaran Shah Mardan! Those who love Shah Mardan, come to the arena! People say for some
people that they have airs. What airs do they have? Look at the airs he has! Where do his airs

come from?! He is the man of the king or sultan. He is in the service of the sultan, and who is
more than he? We are servants of Shah Mardan,our airs come from this. We've his airs of
course. The men of Shah Mardan, can bring down the world! Listen all those who are left
without air, idiot ones! Those who walk on air - Listen, you idiots, who is the one who deserves to
put on airs? "Look at him" they say "he has put on airs". Do you know him? Look the way he
walks, his size. He is putting on airs! He has strong support to give him airs. He has strong
support, that's why he has airs!
Shah Mardan, Sahib Dawran, Habibur-Rahman his excellency. He has airs; when he comes to
the arena of men he has airs of his own. Where does his air come from? From his uncle's son(sas)
from the beloved one of Allah(Habib Allah).That's why he has airs. Hay hay. Oh you idiot ones,
you may easily fall and die. Allah(swt) let him collect his soldiers. These soldiers give him airs.
He says, I am going to fight! Whom? Humans and jinn! You wish! Look to his airs! E what airs
does he have? What do you rely on? Those soldiers in front or your weapons pointed towards the
sky which are worth nothing? Their airs are worth nothing; he thinks his weapons have airs!
shaytan is saying I will destroy, I will burn. Destroy if you can, burn if you can. You are satan you put airs on. Do you think there is no Owner for this domain?! You think these people have
nobody to protect them? You are going far beyond your limits. You may easily fall and die. Have
airs (be proud), like Shah Mardan whose airs are completely different.
Hey the holy one, Shah Mardan! Habibur-Rahman. MashAllah. Here come the brave ones.
Those taking their airs from the Holy ones are blessed. May your airs come from Shah Mardan.
Haa. Airs coming from your weapons are useless. They will destroy you. If Shah Mardan
commands, their cannons, weapons, armour tanks, will not work. Allahu Akbar wa lillahil
Hamd. Ey Son of Adam, keep your limits. What is the most beautiful way that befits man? To
know his limits.
Let’s say Bismillahir rahmanir rahim. Ey Shah Mardan, welcome to the arena. There is no
person on Earth who will not fear from you. You have your own airs. Hay hay. He has his own
airs. When he comes to the arena, the unbelievers who see him, even before he draws his Dhul
Fiqar, find themselves defeated. Oh muslims, where are you? We are men of Ikhwan Muslimin
(Muslim brothers). They don't know what they are talking about. We are Alawi. We are Shia.

Dont say like this. Which one of you is on the way of the Sultan(Shah Mardan)? Which one of
you has the majesty of Shah Mardan? Shah Mardan has the Heybet(majesty) no one else has.
Your cannons, weapons are like match sticks in front of him.
Fear Allah(swt)! Fearing from Allah gives you majesty. Come down and kiss his horse's stirrup.
Oh our Sultan, your wish is our command! Say this to Shah Mardan. Where are you, Alawis?
You are making big troubles using your bitter claims. What do you say? Ey Shah Mardan. Ey
Habibur-Rahman, ay asadullahi l-Ghalib,(the victorious lion of Allah). We are proud of you. We
are on your side. Say like this. Does any one of you say like this? Because his exellency, his
holiness,Shah Mardan has his own airs! Why? He is the enemy of satan. He splits satan into two
hundred pieces, a thousand pieces, leaving him paralyzed.
Who is with satan cannot be Alawi. Anyone who forgot DhikruLlah cannot be Shia. Who is
showing hostility to the Ummah of the Beloved, is not a human being. They will be destroyed.
Know whose side you are you on. Some say 'he is putting on airs'. Airs? Whose airs? He is the
man of such an important person He has strong support, strong support?! That's why he is
putting on airs. Don't you see his shoulder strap(epaulette)? Don't you see how proud he is with
the cap he wears on his head? Why is he proud of the uniform which belongs to an unbeliever's
military. Putting on airs for these things is worth nothing - only for appearance( to show off).
Choose your side. MashaAllah. Shah Mardan is giving advice. Ey Yaran Shah Mardan. O male
lion, Shah Mardan. Those who don't love him have no place in the human race. Those who
don't respect him have no name in the arena. Respect him. Be on his side so that he takes his airs
from such a lion who shakes the world. Being with him, you can of course take airs from him.
Someone drinks, hits, makes trouble, then he says the arena is mine. You drunk one "Do you
think that Shah Mardan is dead and buried?" He is the lion who is next to his Uncle's Son(Hz
Muhammad (sas)). Be on his side so that you deserve to take on his airs. Of course the one on the
side of Shah Mardan is getting airs from him.
Some other man is putting on airs. Who is he? He is the man of the president, or man of the
director of customs, or of the governor general, or marshal, or admiral...So many made up ranks.
Where did you find these foreign words? Why are you using foreign vocabulary? Admirals, being
admirals and generals - They don't like to be Pasha. There is no Pasha in Egypt, nor in Hijaz,
nor in Turkey, nor in Iran either. Take the title Pasha! Isn't there the title of Pasha in Islam? Yes

there is. It is a manly title. If the world bursts with a "boom"; they are the lions who remain
steady. Be a lion you imitation Alawis, fake Shia. You have no value. There is no value if you are
putting on such airs. If you think you found honour by killing people, extinguishing stoves,
oppressing innocent people and destroying their homes - hell, may you go to hell. Neither
admiral nor general are titles belonging to us. There is no general or admiral in Islam. We are
not a made-up nation. We are coming from the nation of Abraham (Ibrahim).We are the lions
on Earth. What is the imperial order to us? Innahu min Suleiman wa innahu Bismillahir
rahmanir rahim. Stand up you fake alawi and fake shia, flying their jet fighters, destroying
innocent people and homes. They are dishonourable people. They are on the side of shaytan.
Oh those who are on the side of Shah Mardan,come and reveal yourselves. They say 'he is
putting on airs'. Of course he is. He is the man of the sultan, or of pasha or of the prefect or of
the governor. That is why he is putting on airs. MashaAllah, this is the level of their
understanding. They say "we are leaders of Muslim Brothers" What about the others? Are they
shaytan brothers. Shame. Why do you make divisions between people? Innamal mu'minuna
ikhwatun. Janabul Haqq is saying, "All Muslims are brothers and sisters". You make divisions
and call yourselves Muslim Brothers(ikhwan muslimin). Shame on you - be ashamed of
yourselves. You have no fear of Allah!
Shah Mardan, Habibur-rahman, if only he shakes - the earth will be shaken by such a lion. Shah
Mardan. Is anyone of you proud of him? Do Iranians say that they are on Shah Mardan's way?
Do Alawis say that they are on his way? They don't because they are oppressors. They are fake.
Their names are fake. They are on shaytan's way. They scatter fires from the sky onto innocent
people who are in their homes. What kind of alawi are you? What kind of shia are you? Such a
shame on you! Don't they know that above them there are heavenly armies of The Owner of the
sky?
It is said that he is putting on airs. Does he have airs to put on? No, these airs are from Shah
Mardan who has the right to put on airs. In this case, he has the right to step like a mardan(man)
on Earth. Our Master Hz.Ali, Shah Mardan, when an unbeliever heard his name, he fell down.
Oh Shah Mardan help us! Finish these fake ones who are oppressing innocent and weak people,
with your Dhul Fiqar. They are firing from Earth. They are firing from the sky. Then they say
"we are alawi, we are shia". Shame on them.

Which side are you on? Are you on Hz.Ali's side? Answer this you shia and alawis. You may not
reach Ramadan. Choose your side. Now you are on shaytan's side. Hz.Ali is Shah Mardan. Is
there any one like him who will be on his way? From far distances they came to rain fire onto the
servants of Allah who are hiding in their homes. Then you walk around and say: I am human. I
am president, I am leader, pasha... Putting airs on, giving themselves airs with such things... why
is he walking on air? Yahu, he is the man of Bashar. What about the other one who is called
Murshi or turshu in Egypt? He is putting on airs too. He has installed himself firmly in his seat!
One day your seat may be broken on your head! Those who are taking airs from shaytan, will go
to hell! Dont forget! We will have to account to our Lord for everything, account for every single
day.
Know this you Iranian, you Alawi, Turks and Kurds - You don't think that Allah created them.
The servants of Allah, these innocent servants, you are raining fire on them. You burn them.
Torment by fire is only the right of Janabul Haqq. No one else has such a right. You can't burn
with fire. You can't burn even a snake in fire. It can complain its Lord; "This servant of yours
burned me in fire!" He wanted to kill me, and he burned me in fire, my Lord! I Punish him! Is
this the civilization of the 21st century?
Where are those Christians whose prophet is Isa(as)? He said to his nation - if someone slaps
your cheek turn the other side to him also. He(Isa(as)) taught the people good manners. His rank
in the presence of Allah, is known by our Prophet (Hz.Muhammad (sas)). The people of the
Prophet Jesus(as), those who follow him or not, we have faith that Isa is RuhuLlah. You even say
more, but then you invent weapons to destroy servants of Allah and their homes. You say your
weapons are putting on airs. America is putting on airs! In Korea people are bewildered by their
even more confused leader who is shouting and screaming: "I will destroy, I will burn". Who do
you think you are? Who are you? Whose side are you on? Everyone has a side. "We",they
say,"are Koreans". China is backing us, Russia is backing us. That is why we are putting on airs,
they say. We dont recognise America or Turks, nor India nor Japan, none of them. Do you?
You idiot, mindless people! You live in between two breaths, the one you take in and the one
you take out. Euer Allah(cc) izin vermese, If Allah doesnt give permission, even if you pump air
into him, he can't survive. He cant wake up, cant breathe in air. If Allah permits he can breath
in. If He permits,the breath comes out. If He doesnt give permission... Haqq who is Khaliq-i

Jabbar and Qahhar let us stand up for His Honour! Do you think world is yours? No it isn't.
Show us your title deed. Show us, give us a proof that Dunya is yours. Russia, China, America,
Europe and Turks, those in Damascus who kill people, fake alawis, bring us your imperial order
that you have permission to destroy children of Adam. If you don't fear from Allah.
Those who are taking sides, are also putting on airs, either airs from shaytan.... shaytan blows his
airs into him! Why are those people who follow shaytan putting on airs? asked one. The holy
one answered: They are putting on airs because they follow shaytan! What does shaytan do?
When it farts it puts the gas in their mouths and noses. Burt,burt, burt Let its dirty gas inside
those people, so they have airs coming from shaytan; they blow up like a balloon. They have a
side. Because of their side, whose side? shaytan's side, shaytan keeps farting into their noses.
When the smell comes they swell up to show off - we are this, we are that. Accept that you are
shaytan! shaytan doesnt let them say this! Satanism only belongs to itself! it doesn't give its rank
to anybody else. These heedless people are becoming, friends of shaytan. They want to take airs
from it.
It is not so easy! Not easy! How are you going to pay so that it gives of its airs? What shall we do?
- Burn, destroy, kill the children of Adam. Destroy their homes, hit their heads! Make a big fire
on Earth. Then it says, "I will give you airs of mine". You can put on my airs. Stalin is shaytan,
Hitler is shaytan, Mussolini is shaytan. There are more of them... They killed millions of people,
not thinking Allah created them. Burned, destroyed. Then they came around showing off and
boasting of their airs. One made his hands like this, another like this. Making shapes with their
hands, they thought to put on airs in this way. Nowadays there are some people who want to
follow them, putting airs on from them. shaytan's airs! They are putting on airs! Where do their
airs come from? shaytan turned its back towards their noses, mouths, they became drunk with its
bad smell. They say: we are Muslim brothers, we are alawi, we are shia - liars all of them.
Shaytan captured their noses, continually farting - zart, zurt,fart,fart,all these who are boasting
with its airs. To their mouths, to their noses, it is farting. Then they begin to walk on air. They
think they are elevated saying; I will destroy, I will burn.
Hey!Hey! There is Allah(swt). There is Allah's Lion. He is Shah Mardan. If you are on his side,
then your airs are coming from Haqq, and are deserved. If one doesn't take airs from Haqq(swt),
he will take airs from shaytan's farts. They are not human but garbage, they are like the waste of

shaytan. They are putting on airs. Where do their airs come from? "We've weapons, missiles. We
aim into the sky,then it turns to fall on people Why are you doing this? What is your reason?
Why do you kill humans? Are you the one who gave them life? One day you will be caught? You
will be set on fire like a barbecue, with your ally shaytan! You will be roasted on the fire, turned
like a barbecue. You went far beyond the limits, you will burn.
Those leaders who are on shaytan's side, shaytan will laugh at you for he is made from fire but
you are from earth. He will laugh at you, saying - they are the ones who were on my side. This
one killed millions of people. This one burned so many people. The other one destroyed a
nation, generation. You will have to come to account. Oh you who are leaders of your nation, do
you have an answer when the Lord will ask, "why did you kill the ones I created"? The leader of
America ,Obama, then, leaders of Russia, China, Your lives are caught between two breaths.
You can easily fall down dead. No doctor can extend help! Watch your manners! Choose your
side! Why are they boasting? Walking on air? Say Shah Mardan, may we listen! With the clothes
they wear they are showing off. Their lives are between two breaths. What is this pride? You can
easily fall down dead.
Oh people come to your senses! Be a man, a brave servant of the Lord! Open up in service of
Shah Mardan. They drew their swords to protect people from the evils of shaytan! Angels came
from heavens to finish the ones who were giving trouble to Man! MashaAllah la quwwata illa
biLlah. Here is Shah Mardan, He will draw his sword against the fake ones, among Turks,
Kurds, Alawis... among Shias, who became heedless, not knowing their Lord. Their heads and
noses are high, but within a second, the Angel of Death can finish them. What is this pride for?
We have already said that they have strong support!??!! They are the men of such people - this is
why they have pride! Is there any power that is mightier than Allah!? Why don't you come to be
Allah's servant, and in the service of Shah Mardan?
Did you get orders from Allah(swt) to kill? Did Allah say you to kill and destroy humans?
Absolutely not. Then you will suffer from what you did! He is putting on airs. Those with airs,
why are they like that? Because, such people and servants of such people they are putting on such
airs! Why? He is the leader of a country which is as strong as a dragon! Putting on airs! Ee your
side, ee our side...We are weak servants of Allah Almighty. We never hurt people, or let them
hurt other people. We won't let them hurt people He is causing what trouble he can but his head

will be crushed under stones. We don't need weapons and cannons, but will catch his head, and
crush it with stones. They are like an asp (snake), they are the shame of the children of Adam!
The ones on their side are condemned too. They are giving each other airs!
How long are they going to put on airs? It is said - chicken, let's see you fly! The chicken is
putting on airs. "Lets see you fly" they say to it. It jumps up a little, and falls down. It is a chicken.
But a hawk, an eagle, a vulture are birds ruling the sky. Allah(swt) dressed them with this rank.
They fly over the world and watch. MashAllah! Today in our world, who knows their limits, and
keeps justice, and performs divine service according to their religion.
There is only one government, only one country that keeps justice according to its laws - the
British Empire. Today there is no other country like Britain, to preserve justice - not Turk, not
Kurd, neither Russia nor Japan! Oh Shah Mardan, you tell them. Tell them the truth. Tell them
what is righteous(haqq).In our world today, Britain/England which used to be a huge empire
from east to west, is still a state/commonwealth of Her Excellency. Keeping justice, still holding
power in its hand. There is no other country who keeps justice like the British Empire. This is
because, their head is respected, well regarded, beloved and Allah knows. They harm or hurt no
one...
We were here (in Cyprus), we were a colony of the British Empire. After the Ottoman Empire, in
this island, the British Empire was keeping justice, under a colony government. Only with five
officers they were ruling the island. Five officers. In the whole island there were 250 police staff.
People were safe and windows and doors were open, not locked. No one was abusing/assaulting
the people. I remember times when the judge was to give the verdict of execution, he had
broken the tip of his pencil. At the beginning of each year, the big court used to gather and the
chief judge used to ask: Is there a murder case? Did someone kill another one? No. Is there a
verdict of execution? No. Then he stood up...He was wearing a red cloak - here in Cyprus. These
things I remember and know. These Cypriots can't remember.
In the palace in Sarayonu, the chief judge used to stand up. There were The Holy Quran and
The Bible in front of him. He used to stand up and in his hand a pencil with which he would
write the verdict of execution. He had broken the tip of it. Then he used to put his hand on the
Bible and kiss it. There was such a ceremony/tradition. They still have it. In today's world I

announce that the British Empire is the only state that still keeps justice. Her Majesty the
Queens' Empire. This is it, they are still number one. Awliyyaullah on Earth know them all. No
matter how much things change on earth, the ceremonies of the British Empire don’t change.
Their respect for their head/queen doesn't change. I am asking long life for the Queen and a
good fate/end.
We had the citizenship of Britain, after the Ottoman Empire. There wasn't injustice in Cyprus.
Those ones who brought injustice to our island, may all of them burn in hell. We told you this
much today. If we elaborate on this subject books can be written on it. There were district
offices. There were 6 districts Let's not say more on this but about public order, and safety - that
good manners used to be taught to people. Today in our world the one who keeps justice is still
Her Majesty the Queen's Government. I know this. There are unchanged laws of Britain. They
teach their people good manners. Where are the others? Others are garbage. They must vanish.
Have you ever heard the British saying, I will burn. Allah knows the power which the British
Empire has. Our Prophet knows too. Awliyyaullah know too, Others cannot know. She(Britain)
seems to be silent but she is like a dragon.
When we were a child we used to say, and I really mean it, may Allah watch over them(royal
family). They kept justice and are still keeping. Allah knows. Allah sees. Allah hears. The most
honorable government in the world, that keeps justice, and gives value to her citizens is Her
Majesty the Queen's government. He who has the citizenship in the British Empire, he is
honoured. Everyone wants but cannot get. Others are putting on airs. Airs. Where do their airs
come from? He is the man of an important man. To put on airs with pride is not a good attribute
of a man and a servant.
Oh our Lord, grant us a state, which will let us be on Your way, bring & perform divine justice,
which will serve Your servants and protect them. May you grant us such a state, so that people
can be saved from oppressors. The Greeks and Turks on this island, were living in peace and
comfort, but the ones who were giving trouble, they are now in their graves. Both on Greek side
& Turkish side. They will give their own account to the Lord. We cannot interfere.
Putting on airs? For what? He is the man of that man. He is on that man's side. O you! Be a man
of Allah Almighty. Then you will see yourself, when you walk everyone will think a lion is

passing by. We want humans to be like this. People who fear from Allah, and are embarrassed in
front of the Lord. People became shameless because of this dirty democratic system. Neither
Arabs nor Turks, have any goodness any more. Allah will send them someone who will deal and
finish their wrong doings. A few men but they are giving big trouble. Damascus is burned,
destroyed. Another oppressor from the Far East is saying I will burn, I will destroy! But you are
caught between two breaths. How can you talk like this?
We are on the side of Shah Mardan. We are against oppression. We have the power to finish
their oppression! Allah(jj), Allahu Akbar Allahu Akbar Allahu Akbar wa lillahil Hamd. Ya
Rabbi. Shukur Ya Rabbi. Today, our talk was rather long. So many people were charged.The
words of Shah Mardan are severe! I am warning those who are rejecting, may pass away by the
sword of Sh. Mardan. They may not reach Ramadan! Amin,amin.Wa s-salamu ala l-mursalin,
Hususan ala sayyidi l-mursalin. Wal Hamdu lillahir Rabbi l alamin. Lets recite Fatiha to present
to Shah Mardan. May greetings go to his followers from his followers! The Master of the
universe, our Prophet - may countless salatu salam (holy greetings) go to him. May he sends us
one like Shah Mardan who will destroy oppressors. Amin, amin. Salamun ala l mursalin wal
Hamdu lillahi Rabbul alamin.
Al-Fatiha.
